text:
oliver: FYI seeing a TLS handshake spike in apac around 2026-03-20T21:05Z. lots of alert 40s from proxy sidecars. opening thread to correlate with the keystore RBAC change earlier today.

tara: can you paste a sample log?

oliver: snippet: `2026-03-20T21:06:12Z proxy[edge]: tls: handshake failure (alert 40) peer=svc-ingest.apac.internal`

sam: we rolled a tighter KMS policy at 09:00Z (scoped decrypt to keystore-rotator@infra). apac was last region. rotator logs show `AccessDeniedException: Missing kms:Decrypt` during key unwrap.

infra-bot: alert: TLS-handshake-failure-rate apac=6.2% over 5m. incident: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-APAC-TLS-02

oliver: auditor-bot, can you check KMS denies in the 09:00-21:00 window?

auditor-bot: found denies for kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:apac:111:key/abcd: principals ["proxy-sidecar@apac","cert-rotator@apac"] timeframe 2026-03-20T09:00Z-21:10Z. link: https://logs.internal/apac/kms/6661002222

tara: that explains it. proxy sidecar also unwraps session ticket keys; when decrypt fails, resumed sessions break and we see transient handshakes.

sam: plan: 1) rollback RBAC to previous decrypt permissions 2) restart rotator & sidecar pods 3) collect audit logs and confirm restored traffic 4) create scoped allowlist (rotator + proxy-sidecar per region) + VPC condition before re-enforcing.

oliver: rolling rollback now. will watch metrics.

infra-bot: update: TLS-handshake-failure-rate apac down to 0.8% at 21:18Z.

tara: postmortem items: - explicit per-service KMS allowlist - CI dry-run test for rotator decrypt permission - alert rule: correlate KMS Denies with TLS errors - document RBAC rollback playbook and verifier script.

sam: opened PR 8399 for scoped policy with VPC condition and rollback steps.

oliver: keeping thread open until global verification complete. :white_check_mark:
